0022600114.text: The Knicks (0-2) host the Orlando Magic (0-2) in the third game of New York's season, with both teams on two-game losing streaks and sitting 12th and 14th in the East, respectively. Jose Alvarado is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision for New York, while Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Anthony Black is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Knicks winning the last meeting 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025, and no games have been played yet this season.
